transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… my talking’s been getting mixed up. I try to explain something, like the keys, then I’m talking about jail, or a prayer rug, or chess pieces, and… people say they can’t follow me. So that’s why I came.
Do you feel that your thoughts are connected in a way that others should understand, even if they don’t see the connection right away?
Yeah… to me it’s connected, sort of. Like the keys, then jail, then the prayer rug, then chess pieces—it makes sense in my head at the time. But when I say it, people say they can’t follow it.
Do you ever believe things that others don’t seem to believe, or have thoughts that feel very different from what most people think?

Yeah… I mean, maybe. At work I felt like the building people had kind of… marked me. Like the hallway lights and the little looks they gave each other were warnings about me. My supervisor showed me the camera and said there was nothing there, but I still felt sure about it.
Do you often feel like things in your environment, like people's actions or objects, have a special meaning or are directed at you in some way?

Yeah… I do. Like at the building, the lights in the hall and the way people looked at each other… it felt like it was about me. Even when my supervisor showed me the camera and said there wasn’t anything, I still felt like they’d marked me somehow.
Do you ever hear things that other people don't hear, like voices or sounds that aren't actually there?
Yeah… sometimes. I hear a man’s voice, like from the vents or the mop closet. Says my name, or says I ruined everything. It sounds… real, like he’s right there.

Do you ever feel that you have a special role, mission, or connection that other people don’t have, like you’re meant to do something important or that things in the world are referring directly to you?
Yeah… sometimes I get that feeling. Like I’m the one who can fix the whole building, like I see what the bosses don’t. I don’t know… maybe people would know me for it, if they understood.
